messages:
Nina: Quick Q for managers 1: How should we surface benefits-related accommodations in OKRs and self-reviews? e.g., parental leave, phased return, disability adjustments. Want guidance so folks don't feel penalized but reviewers have context.

Carlos: Good one. Suggest two parts: (1) a private accommodations line in manager notes, (2) a public self-review impact line focused on work outcomes achieved, not calendar days.

Mei: Agree. Example pasteables would help. Also add a one-liner for calibration: "do not penalize timeline variance due to approved accommodations".

people-ops-bot: Saved to /templates/policies/benefits-review-guidance  internal

Nina: Pasteable guidance for managers (copy into private manager notes):
- Private accommodation note (1L): "Employee had approved [accommodation], discussed with HR on [date]; please consider in timeline/availability review."
- Public self-review guidance (1-2L): "Focus review on outcomes: 'Delivered X feature by adjusting scope and using async reviews; outcome Y achieved.' Avoid listing private medical details."

Carlos: Pasteable self-review examples (for ICs):
- "Led rollout of onboarding docs; measured 15% drop in support tickets post-launch. Managed timeline with reduced weekly capacity due to approved phased return."
- "Drove model evaluation and shipped trimmed scope MVP; kept quality targets and delivered artifact links."

Mei: Calibration note (pasteable):
- "Calibration reminder: approved accommodations are factored into timeline expectations; discuss impact on scope, not capability. Flag any concerns to People Ops."

Nina: Manager coaching prompts (1L each):
- "How can we re-scope to preserve impact while respecting capacity?"
- "What support does the employee need from teammates or infra?"
- "Can we document a single evidence artifact to validate progress?"

Carlos: Tiny legal note: keep medical specifics in HR ticket or private doc, not in reviews.

Mei: :heart: This should make reviews more humane and consistent. Can people-ops add a short FAQ linking to benefits policy?

people-ops-bot: Done  FAQ added and broadcast scheduled for Tuesday 11am PT to #managers.

Nina: Thanks all  I'll pin the snippets in the manager templates and run a 10-min drop-in demo next week.
